record.evidence_quote: such as silver iodide and Li10GeP2S12 exhibit high ion conductivities of ~1 S/cm5 and ~0.01 S/cm 6, 7 at room temperature respectively
record.notes: Literature value cited from refs 6 and 7, not measured in this paper. The paper's own Li3.042Ge0.042P0.958O4 results are diffusivities (cm2/s) and D_sigma values, not ionic conductivities in S/cm, so no records were made for them. Yttria-stabilized zirconia (oxygen ion) and silver iodide (Ag ion) values were excluded as not Li/Na conductors.
